note: Follow-up conditions added after the first results. The Sonnet baseline contains no em dash, so banning em dashes removes nothing. no_colon and no_paren ban the two marks the baseline uses most. plain_prose removes headings and lists so that marks can be compared in running prose. {prompt} is replaced by the brief's plain prompt.

plain_prose.template:
{prompt}

Write it as plain prose with no headings or lists.
